about: Every constraint and applied force a take's physics may use, declared (plan 5.1, shortcuts are declared; docs/moonshot/physics.md, Declared shortcuts). moonshot/validate/shortcuts.py fails a take that uses anything not listed here by name or fnmatch pattern. `shortcuts` are non-physical assists, each standing in for something the scene can't model, reported with how long it was on; `grip_assist` ones count toward the deformable-pad trigger (plan 3.1). `mechanisms` are the model's own structure: the body's couplings, the vise's screw ratio and its AngLock; a force is named "force on <body>". Protected (plan 6, rule 1): declaring a shortcut is moving the bar.

enclose.stands_in_for: Flesh conforming round the crank's knob, which capsule fingers can't

screw_lock.stands_in_for: The lead screw self-locking under clamp load

keep_para_*.stands_in_for: Parallels resting under their own friction until checked

keep_stop.stands_in_for: The stop held where it was set, as a vise stop's clamp holds it, for the part to be set against

clamped.stands_in_for: The vise's clamp on the part in the steps after it is tightened (Find X and Y, Set Z), where nothing pushes on the part; the Seat step's take proves the clamp itself

dial_pinch.stands_in_for: Fingertips' grip on the jog handle's knurled rim while a stroke turns it, which capsule fingers on a smooth cylinder can't hold without slipping

carry_*.stands_in_for: Fingers' hold on what a hand carries, which capsule fingers can't keep steady: the object welded to the hand for the carry. A hand tool carried and used at the inspection bench (the deburr blade, the caliper; your decision 2026-11-03), and a part or tool a step take carries (the parallels, the stop, the air gun: moonshot/sim/runner.py eq_name; your decision 2026-11-04)

dial_lock.stands_in_for: The jog handle's detent holding it where the hand left it: outside a stroke's grip the handle is locked at its detent, as a hand placing itself on the rim, regripping it and coming off it doesn't turn it, where capsule fingers lagging their plan by centimetres brush it round; and the click that brings the machine to a jog's number locks it, as the hand stops on the number

mechanisms.lead_screw: The vise's lead screw as an exact ratio (moonshot/world/vise.py)
mechanisms.saw_vise_screw: The band saw's vise screw as an exact ratio of its handwheel, as the Kurt vise's lead_screw (moonshot/world/bandsaw.py; declared a mechanism, your decision 2026-11-04)
mechanisms.force on moving_jaw: Kurt's AngLock: the moving jaw's angled nut pushes it down as it clamps, modelled as a downward force of 5% of the clamp force on the jaw (moonshot/sim/vise_take.py ANGLOCK; declared a mechanism, your decision 2026-11-03)
